g.text: SEONGWOO CHOI / IT JOURNAL
Difference Between Parental Benefit and Child Allowance:
Application Order for Children Aged 0–23 Months and
Under 9
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-11-10
Parental benefit: Children aged 0–23
months
The parental benefit is for families raising
children aged 0–23 months.
Child allowance: Children under age 9
The child allowance is for children under age 9.
Can both be received during the same
period?
According to guidance from the Ministry of
Health and Welfare and the Ministry of Gender
Equality and Family, only one of the parental…
Application deadline and retroactive
payments
According to Bokjiro guidance, if you apply
within 60 days of the date of birth, including
